name: 2.9.22 - Buffalo Fill updates itself
notes: Tempe Buffalo Fill 1.0.4 updates itself from the helper: about once a minute while Chrome is open (no Buffalo page needed), when Chrome starts and when its button is opened, never in the middle of a fill. If a reload doesn't take it tries again 10 minutes later (3 times in all); if it still can't update itself its button shows a red ! and the helper's Fill line says what to click. After updating the helper, 1.0.3 updates itself to 1.0.4 once a Create Consignment page shows in Chrome (no click needed), or click Reload on it in chrome://extensions. Keep Developer mode on in chrome://extensions. Nothing is saved in Buffalo or changed in COSTAR. Not yet tried on the RDP PC. Update the RDP helper (and the desk PC, to keep them the same).
